upstreams.fields: GTFS agency, routes, trips, stop_times, stops, calendar, calendar_dates — compiled to minute-resolution patterns over a 14-day window

cadenceBasis.observed: Entur: «all data dumps … are updated daily»; the file was last modified 2026-11-20 23:15 UTC (read 2026-11-21). The bundle holds a 14-day window (WINDOW_DAYS), so it is rebuilt every three days: the window never has fewer than 11 days left, and a date beyond it is refused (js/transit-raptor.js coverage)
cadenceBasis.expires: if the publisher moves to a different schedule, or WINDOW_DAYS changes

autoRefresh: one read of https://developer.entur.org/stops-and-timetable-data and one archive download (storage.googleapis.com), no key; the build refuses to run when the page no longer states «License: NLOD»; the archive must contain a calendar covering a day from today on, and nothing is written when any of that fails
